findings.layer: S2/Headline (52:791 / 42:15426) against the top edge of S2/Band window (52:776 / 42:15364)
findings.problem: The edge of the band slices through the 'Ash Vase' baseline for the whole product hold. The band top is fixed at y 600, but S2/Type drifts up 15 px, so the headline crosses the edge. Measured lowest headline ink against the band top: 11 px into the grey on f130, 9 on f140, 5 on f155 and 3 on f160, then tangent at f165 (serifs on y 598–601). It never reads as either 'standing on the shelf' or 'clear of it': it reads as type being cut by a moving line. This is the ad's highest-value frame (product, name, price), and r2's F9 intended the headline to sit fully on cream. See design/f135-headline-edge.png and design/headline-band-5.5.png.

The mug stack is too tall for the kiln arch. On f207 the top cup's rim corner sits only about 7 px under the arch curve at about (475, 815), and its handle runs into the curve. The upward pan (TRANSLATION_Y 0 → −24 by 7.2) drives the rim further into the curve until the cut. The result is a near-tangent at the most visible point of the arch. See design/arch-mug-6.9.png.
findings.fix:
Replace the pan with a slow push from a smaller start, the same device the plates use:

- delete the TRANSLATION_Y track (@0 0 · @6 0 L · @7.2 −24 L);
- add SCALE_XY @0 0.94,0.94 · @6 0.94,0.94 L · @7.2 0.97,0.97 L.

The pivot is the rect centre, screen (344, 1108). Expected clearance at 7.2: rim about 35 px under the arch curve, base about 40 px above the window bottom (1480), left handles about 60 px inside the left edge.

findings.problem: The dinner plate's rim is tangent to both straight sides of the arch: x ≈ 66–68 against the left edge at 64, and x ≈ 590 against the right edge at about 592 (f237, design/plates-edges.png). The SCALE_XY push 1 → 1.03 then carries both rims across the edges. The plate is neither cleanly inside nor decisively cropped, so the frame looks accidental.
findings.fix:
Pull the stack decisively inside the arch:

- S3/Plates SCALE_XY @0 0.9,0.9 · @7.2 0.9,0.9 L · @8.1 0.93,0.93 L, replacing 1 → 1.03. The pivot is the rect centre, screen about (314, 1027).
- Expected result: rims about 20–29 px inside each side through 8.1, and the bottom plate about 90 px above the window bottom.
- Keep the OPACITY cut pairs unchanged.

findings.problem: Two lines on the end card share one style (Cormorant Garamond Medium Italic, clay #d6cab8, stacked 120 px apart) but use near-equal sizes: the tagline is 56 px and 'your first order.' is 60 px. A 7 % difference reads as a mistake rather than a hierarchy. The pair is plainly visible in the end-card stills (check-12.600.png, check-14.367.png).
